backend/main.mo: Empty actor canister placeholder with no implemented logic.
feature_evidence.json: Metadata describing implemented features, related files, components, and test IDs for two summary‑handling features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Aggregated description file listing short functional summaries for key frontend components.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment file showing where to define the ActivePieces webhook URL.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Guide explaining how to create build drafts, run the pipeline, deploy, and troubleshoot webhook or build issues.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining OKLCH color tokens, theme variables, and dark-mode overrides.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point mounting the React app and setting the page title.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root component that checks Internet Identity status and routes users to sign-in or the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/AskAI/AskAIModul: UI module enabling users to submit AI questions, view responses, show errors, and clear inputs.
frontend/src/components/FileUpload.tsx: Drag‑and‑drop file upload component with file selection, preview, validation, and upload actions.
Defines the main app layout with header, sign-out button, content area, and footer branding.
frontend/src/components/Quiz/Interactive: Interactive quiz renderer that highlights correct answers in green and incorrect selections in red after choosing.
frontend/src/components/Quiz/QuizSection: Renders a quiz section with visibility toggle and delete option, displaying questions through InteractiveQuiz. Uses state to show or hide quiz content.
frontend/src/components/SummaryCard.tsx: Displays a text summary split into paragraphs with optional delete button, or a placeholder when no summary exists.
frontend/src/components/WebhookSetupHelp: Provides UI for configuring, validating, saving, and clearing a webhook URL with status messages. Shows current saved URL and handles form input and errors.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context, providing identity state, login, logout, and initialization handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base configuration defining theme variables, dark mode values, and global styles.
frontend/src/lib/activepieces.ts: Handles file upload and AI queries via webhook with fallback offline processing and strict response validation.
frontend/src/lib/env.ts: Provides utilities to check and retrieve the active webhook URL from overrides or environment variables.
frontend/src/lib/offlineNoteProcessing.t: Handles extracting text from files, generating summaries, and creating basic quiz questions from note content.
frontend/src/lib/pdfTextExtraction.ts: Loads PDF.js from CDN and extracts plain text from PDF files in the browser.
frontend/src/lib/types.ts: Defines interfaces for quiz items, upload responses, and AI responses.
frontend/src/lib/webhookOverride.ts: Manages user-configurable webhook URL overrides with validation and localStorage persistence.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React application with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Implements the dashboard for uploading notes, displaying summaries, showing quizzes, and handling related UI states.
frontend/src/pages/SignInPage.tsx: Displays the sign‑in screen using Internet Identity with related UI and error handling.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme, colors, plugins, and responsive settings.
frontend/WEBHOOK_SETUP.md: Documentation describing how to configure the ActivePieces webhook URL for local development and production.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature requirements, issues, and state tracking information.
